name: Comic Road
source:
Comic Road is a "life simulation" game, starring a young girl (whom the player names themselves) who dreams of becoming a manga artist. In order to become successful, she has to do more than just draw well; it is important to develop other aspects of her personality, and also keep an eye on the finances, otherwise working too much might deteriorate her drawing skills. Social life, physical exercises, reading - everything has consequences!

The gameplay consists mainly of making decisions (through menu choices); there is no player character navigation in the game, except shops, which are viewed from first-person perspective. There is a variety of ways to manage the girl's life. The player can make a schedule for a whole month, or decide every day what to do. Every action has an effect on the heroine's parameters. For example, just resting every day reduces physical shape and appeal. Working on the manga increases respective skills. It is possible to call friends and spend time with them, or go shopping. There are many items in the game, all of which influence the heroine's stats in that or another way - for example clothes, drawing accessories, books, or even a PC-FX console, that can be bought in an electronics store for about 20000 yen.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/comicroad]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《Comic Road》是一款“人生模拟”游戏，主人公是一名由玩家命名、梦想成为漫画家的年轻女孩。想要成功，她不能只顾着磨炼画技；培养性格的其他方面同样重要，还必须时刻关注收支，否则过度工作反而可能导致绘画能力下降。社交生活、锻炼身体、阅读……每件事都会带来相应的结果！

游戏主要通过菜单选项作出决定；除了采用第一视角呈现的商店外，玩家不能直接操纵角色四处移动。管理少女生活的方式多种多样：玩家既可以一次安排整月日程，也可以每天决定当天要做什么。每项行动都会影响女主人公的能力数值。例如，每天只顾休息会使体能与魅力下降，绘制漫画则会提高相关技能。玩家还能打电话约朋友见面、与他们共度时光，或出门购物。游戏内有大量物品，每件都会以不同方式影响女主人公的能力，包括服装、绘画用具、书籍，甚至还有一台能在电器店花约20000日元买到的PC-FX主机。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/comicroad]Moby Games[/url]]
